mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those activities that learners are engaged in in the process of learning."
Learning experiences are those activities that learners are engaged in in the process of learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous progression beginning early and going on after leaving the school at whatever level."
Writing is a continuous progression beginning early and going on after leaving the school at whatever level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those the learners use all the time while the passive words are those used occasionally."
The active words are those the learners use all the time while the passive words are those used occasionally.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means "get meaning out of", therefore reading comprehension means "getting meaning out of what is read"."
Comprehend means "get meaning out of", therefore reading comprehension means "getting meaning out of what is read".

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the subject of unit 1; how to prepare your learners for public examinations is the focus for Unit 2 while how you can organize and sustain an English Department is what you are shown in Unit 3."

The evaluation of English is the subject of unit 1; how to prepare your learners for public examinations is the focus for Unit 2 while how you can organize and sustain an English Department is what you are shown in Unit 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a veritable tool in improving the language use of the learners."
Literature is a veritable tool in improving the language use of the learners.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a source of difficulty because Nigerian languages are tonal. 3.4 Stress and Rhythm English words do carry stress and this can vary according to the meaning of the sentence as a whole."
Intonation is a source of difficulty because Nigerian languages are tonal. 3.4 Stress and Rhythm English words do carry stress and this can vary according to the meaning of the sentence as a whole.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the need to read rapidly."
Underlying these two skills is the need to read rapidly.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a guide or manual that tells the teacher about the nature and characteristics of the learners to teach, the content to teach, the methods and strategies to use to teach and assess learners."

Curriculum is a guide or manual that tells the teacher about the nature and characteristics of the learners to teach, the content to teach, the methods and strategies to use to teach and assess learners.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way or manner of approaching and solving a problem or task."
Strategies A strategy is a way or manner of approaching and solving a problem or task.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an L2 in Nigeria and there are bound to be mother tongue interferences in the production of the sounds of L2 by your learners."
English is an L2 in Nigeria and there are bound to be mother tongue interferences in the production of the sounds of L2 by your learners.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of making decision about the worth of something, its quality and quantity."
Evaluation in curriculum is the process of making decision about the worth of something, its quality and quantity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used mainly to facilitate familiarity with a large body of reading materials."
Extensive Reading is used mainly to facilitate familiarity with a large body of reading materials.
